title: Synthesis and characteristics of water-based, rosin-modified, polymerized oil based on dehydrated castor oil acid and zinc resinate
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1690-1697
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA03350G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong-A. Choe, Su-Il Kim, Jong-Hwan Jang, Kyong-Sik Ju
In this study, we synthesized a water-based, rosin-modified, polymerized oil (WRPO) via an addition and polymerization reaction of dehydrated castor oil (DCO), rosin acid (RA), zinc resinate (ZR) and dehydrated castor oil acid (DCOA).
